definitions.explanation: Multiple locations, not just one specific place.
Many different places throughout an area.

examples.japanese: あちこち⟦{探|さが}しました→探す：00493_sagasu⟧。

examples.english: There are books all over the room.

examples.japanese: あちこち⟦{旅行|りょこう}しました→旅行：00748_ryokou⟧。
⟦{体|からだ}→体：00784_karada⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧あちこち⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{痛|いた}い→痛い：01108_itai⟧。
⟦{猫|ねこ}→猫：02237_neko⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧あちこち⟦{探|さが}した→探す：00493_sagasu⟧⟦けど→けど：09477_kedo⟧⟦{見|み}つからなかった→見つかる：01173_mitsukaru⟧。
examples.english: I searched all over for the cat but couldn't find it.

examples.english: Various parts of the house have gotten old.

notes:
あちこち means here and there or various places.

USAGE:
- As noun: あちこちに/で/を + verb
- As adverb: あちこち + verb

VARIATIONS:
- あちらこちら: same meaning (slightly more formal)
- あっちこっち: same meaning (casual)

COMMON PATTERNS:
- あちこち{見|み}る (look around various places)
- あちこちに{散|ち}らばる (scattered here and there)
- あちこち{行|い}く (go to various places)
